bio.text: Tom Wright, a Republican, represents District 8 in the Florida Senate, elected in 2018, according to the Florida Senate.
The Senate lists Wright as a retired businessman born in Rochester, Minnesota, who moved to Florida in 2004.
The profile lists service on the Volusia County Code Enforcement board and the Volusia County Affordable Housing Authority board, and as a volunteer police K9 officer.

sources.title: Senator Tom A. Wright - Florida Senate
